Home.title: Smart Campus Event Manager System
Home.metaDescription: Discover events at the University of Hail, book a seat and enter with a QR ticket.
Home.headline: Every campus event, in one place.
Home.lead: Discover what's happening at the University of Hail, book your seat in seconds and walk in with a QR ticket.

features.title: One system for the whole event
features.subtitle: From the first announcement to the last seat.

discover.title: Discover
discover.body: Browse upcoming events and filter them by category, venue or day.

book.title: Book and attend
book.body: Reserve a seat, keep your QR ticket on your phone, and cancel if your plans change.

organize.title: Organize
organize.body: Organizers publish events and follow bookings; admins review every event before it goes live.

upcoming.title: Coming up
upcoming.subtitle: The next events open for booking.
upcoming.emptyBody: New events appear here as soon as they are approved.

Register.title: Create account
Register.subtitle: Choose the kind of account you need.
Register.success: Your account was created. You can log in now.
Register.attendeeHint: Browse events and book your seat.
Register.organizerHint: Propose an event and send it for approval.
Register.phoneHint: Shown to the admin only, in case they need to reach you about your request.
Register.organizationHint: The body you are organizing for, if any.
Register.organizerNote: Every event you propose is reviewed by an admin before attendees can see it. You can send one request at first; once it is approved you can send as many as you like.
Register.successOrganizer: Your organizer account is ready. Log in to send your first event request.

noAccess.ORGANIZER: The organizer dashboard is only for Organizer accounts.

Organizer.title: My events
Organizer.subtitle: Create events and follow their approval and bookings.
Organizer.emptyBody: Create your first event. An admin reviews it before attendees can see it.
Organizer.deleteConfirm: Delete this event? This cannot be undone.

form.createSubtitle: New events are sent to an admin for approval before attendees can see them.
form.title: Title
form.capacityHint: Cannot exceed the venue's capacity or go below seats already booked.

form.attachmentsHint: Optional. One link per line, up to 10.

form.notEditable: This event can no longer be edited.

attendeesPage.title: Attendees
attendeesPage.empty: No one has registered for this event yet.

limit.title: Your request is with the admin
limit.body: You can send one request at first. As soon as an admin approves it, you can send as many as you like.

checkIn.title: Check-in
checkIn.manualBody: If the camera cannot read a ticket, type the code printed under its QR, or find the person in the attendee list.
checkIn.closedNotApproved: Check-in opens once an admin approves this event.
checkIn.closedEnded: This event has ended, so check-in is closed.

scanner.hint: Hold the ticket’s QR code inside the frame.
scanner.unsupportedTitle: This browser cannot scan QR codes
scanner.unsupportedBody: Use Chrome or Edge (on Android or a computer) to scan. Here you can still type the code or check people in from the attendee list.
scanner.deniedBody: Allow the camera for this site in the browser settings, then try again.
scanner.failedBody: Another app may be using it. Close it and try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: What needs your attention across the platform.

events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Approve, reject or remove events from any organizer.
events.deleteConfirm: Delete this event permanently? Its bookings are deleted too.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Create staff accounts and manage who can sign in.
users.createHint: For Organizer and Admin accounts. People can also create their own Attendee or Organizer account from the registration page.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: The categories organizers choose from when they create an event.
categories.name: Name

broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.subtitle: Send an announcement to every active user.
broadcast.confirm: Send this to all active users? It cannot be recalled.
